inputBoundary: One already-derived music-playback log record with track metadata, time, and a finite nonnegative listened duration expressed in seconds.
outputBoundary: For the Figure 3d descriptive music-count input only, exclude the playback record at or below 30 seconds and retain it only when listened duration is strictly greater than 30 seconds; equality is excluded.
limitations: This binding does not collect or parse music-player broadcast events or playlist history.
This binding does not infer playback segmentation, merge repeated or resumed track plays, deduplicate records, or derive listened duration.
This binding does not construct last-24-hour challenge-question answers, sample correct tracks, or choose distractors.
This binding does not group retained playback records by participant/day or calculate the Figure 3d song-count distribution.
A missing, non-finite, or negative listened duration fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
